segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ לֹא יִתְיַיחֵד אָדָם עִם שְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים, אֲבָל אִשָּׁה אַחַת מִתְיַיחֶדֶת עִם שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים. רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: אַף אִישׁ אֶחָד מִתְיַיחֵד עִם שְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים בִּזְמַן שֶׁאִשְׁתּוֹ עִמּוֹ, וְיָשֵׁן עִמָּהֶם בְּפוּנְדְּקִי, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁאִשְׁתּוֹ מְשַׁמַּרְתּוֹ. מִתְיַיחֵד אָדָם עִם אִמּוֹ וְעִם בִּתּוֹ וְיָשֵׁן עִמָּהֶם בְּקֵירוּב בָּשָׂר. וְאִם הִגְדִּילוּ – זוֹ יְשֵׁנָה בִּכְסוּתָהּ וְזֶה יָשֵׁן בִּכְסוּתוֹ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A man may not be secluded with two women» lest he sin with them, «but one woman may be secluded with two men. Rabbi Shimon says: Even one man may be secluded with two women when his wife is with him, and» in that situation he may even «sleep in» the same «inn» with two women, «because his wife guards him» from sinning with them. They further said that «a man may be secluded with his mother, and with his daughter, and sleep alongside them with bodily contact» without clothes, since there is no concern that they will engage in sexual intercourse. «And when they,» the son or daughter, «have grown up, this one sleeps in her garment and that one sleeps in his garment,» but they may share a bed.
